title: FlashX: Scaling Robotic Experience Reuse for Embodied Agents with CBA-Based NAND Flash
abstract: arXiv:2611.25580v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied agents are emerging as a promising paradigm for complex robotic tasks, leveraging Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) to generate actions through Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based iterative denoising. However, existing models often struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution (OOD) environments. We observe that retrieving successful experiences and using them to warm-start denoising enables agents to better adapt to unfamiliar situations while reducing computational overhead. This creates a new opportunity to improve task accuracy and inference efficiency simultaneously, in contrast to conventional acceleration techniques that trade accuracy for computation. However, realizing this opportunity requires scaling experience banks, introducing substantial storage and search overhead that challenges the capacity, bandwidth, and power constraints of edge systems. translated_title: FlashX：基于CBA型NAND闪存的具身智能体机器人经验复用扩展
translated_abstract: 具身智能体正成为解决复杂机器人任务的一种有前景的范式，它利用视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM），通过基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的迭代去噪来生成动作。然而，现有模型往往难以泛化到分布外（OOD）环境。我们观察到，检索成功经验并将其用于热启动去噪过程，能够使智能体更好地适应陌生情况，同时降低计算开销。与传统的以牺牲精度换取计算加速的技术不同，这创造了一个能够同时提升任务准确性和推理效率的新机会。然而，要实现这一机会就需要扩展经验库的规模，这会带来巨大的存储和检索开销，对边缘系统的容量、带宽和功耗约束构成挑战。我们提出了FlashX，一种CMOS直接键合的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FlashX系统，利用CMOS直接键合的CBA型NAND闪存来扩展机器人经验库的存储规模，通过检索成功经验对扩散模型去噪进行热启动，从而在边缘设备上同时提升具身智能体的任务准确性与推理效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FlashX, a system that leverages CBA-based NAND flash with CMOS direct bonding to scale robotic experience banks, enabling embodied agents to warm-start diffusion denoising with retrieved successful experiences and thereby improve both task accuracy and inference efficiency on edge devices.
